text: Ireland’s external position in 2025 is preliminarily assessed as moderately stronger than the level implied by medium-term fundamentals and desirable policies. The CA surplus declined to 8.2 percent of GDP in 2025, compared to an EBA norm of 1.9 percent of GDP and an EBA CA gap of 6.7 percent of GDP, while the NIIP improved to -48 percent of GDP. Trade policy and investment shocks, geopolitical conflicts, and domestic supply-side constraints are key near-term risks. Staff recommends short-term fiscal policy support public investment within a broadly neutral fiscal stance.
